Candidate statement URLs: the Alameda County ROV candidate list does not link statements; none recorded.

No Alameda County (countywide) offices appear in the ROV Nov 3 2026 list (categories are only Federal, State, School Districts, Special Districts, City). DA race was decided in June per Wikipedia; no county runoffs found.

San Francisco: no local contests missing. SF Dept. of Elections candidate page and Voter Information Pamphlet list only Assessor-Recorder, Public Defender, Supervisors D2/4/6/8/10, Board of Education, Community College Board (full and remainder term), and BART District 8, all already in contests.json. SF names in contests.json match sf.gov exactly. SF page reports 0 write-ins.

MISMATCH: Berkeley Unified School Board (2026-11-03.ca-alameda-sd-berkeley-unified-school-district.school-board-director): contests.json has 'Ka'Dijah Brown'; ROV prints 'KA'DIJAH A. BROWN' (middle initial).
MISMATCH: Berkeley Unified School Board: ROV list also includes 'REICHI LEE', designation 'Write-in Candidate', Filing Completed. Qualified write-in, not printed on the ballot; not in contests.json.
MISMATCH: Hayward Council District 1: contests.json has 'Brian M Schott'; ROV prints 'BRIAN M. SCHOTT' (period after initial).

MISMATCH: Alameda (city) Mayor: contests.json has 'Tracy L. Jensen'; ROV prints 'TRACY JENSEN' (no middle initial). ROV designations (missing in contests.json): Tony Daysog 'Councilmember/Urban Planner', Tracy Jensen 'Councilmember/Nonprofit Director', Malia Vella 'Businesswoman/Educator'.

MISMATCH: Alameda (city) City Council: names match, but contests.json has seats null; ROV says Vote For 2. ROV designations: Amarasiriwardena 'Software Product Manager', Bondonno 'Public Service Attorney', Johnson 'Social Worker', Savage 'Technology Partner Manager', Slauson 'Small Business Owner', White 'Environmental Nonprofit Executive'.
MISMATCH: Emeryville City Council: contests.json has 'Kalimah Priforce'; ROV prints 'KALIMAH ATREYU PRIFORCE'.
MISMATCH: Piedmont City Council: contests.json has 'N. "Sunny" Bostrom-Fleming'; ROV prints 'SUNNY BOSTROM-FLEMING'.
MISMATCH: EBMUD Ward 3: contests.json has 'Donald Gray'; ROV prints 'DON GRAY' (designation 'Retired Wastewater Manager').

All other existing Alameda contests (Oakland mayor/D2/D4/D6/auditor, OUSD D2/D4/D6, Berkeley D1/D4/D7/D8/auditor/rent board, Hayward mayor/D6, Albany council and school board, Union City D2/D3/D4, San Leandro mayor/D1/D2/D3/D5, EBMUD Ward 7) match the ROV list by name and candidate set. Ignoring capitalization, the ROV prints accents as in contests.json (González, López).
Withdrawn or incomplete filings excluded: Linda Hurley (Sunol Glen), Kate Runyon (LVJUSD Area 3), Mark Williams (AC Transit W4), Heriberto Perez (AC Transit W5), Shanavaz Nasarabadi (LARPD).
